issues.desc: Prior execution-boundary completeness issue is resolved: packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts is now allowed. However, init_preflight now reports scope-freeze-check.json is stale relative to the updated execution boundary, so the INIT artifacts are not mechanically fresh for INIT_CHECK until scope_freeze_check is rerun by the owning flow.
